content.title: OpenClaw-Linked Chinese AI Stocks Jump After Nvidia CEO’s Bullish Remarks - Bloomberg
content.text: The AI Race:The Iran War and AIGemini Mac AppBorrowing BoomBonanza or Bubble?Historic RAM ShortagesOpenClaw ManiaBackForwardMarketsFacebookXLinkedInEmailLinkGiftExpandJensen HuangPhotographer: David Paul Morris/BloombergFacebookXLinkedInEmailLinkGiftGift this articleAdd us on GoogleContact us:Provide news feedback or report an errorConfidential tip?Send a tip to our reportersSite feedback:Take our SurveyNew WindowFacebookXLinkedInEmailLinkGiftBy Bloomberg NewsMarch 18, 2026 at 12:12 AM CDTUpdated on March 18, 2026 at 2:05 AM CDTBookmarkSaveTranslateTakeaways by Bloomberg AISubscribeChinese shares related to OpenClaw jumped, buoyed by bullish comments from Nvidia Corp.’s chief on the potential of artificial intelligence agents. MiniMax Group Inc., which just releasedBloomberg Terminal a new self-evolving agent, extended earlier gains to climb as much as 29% to a record high. Knowledge Atlas Technology JSC Ltd., known as Zhipu, rose as much as 23%, while Cloud services provider UCloud Technology Co. also gained in Shanghai.
